overview: This 332-page file combines Japanese Foreign Office studies of prewar living standards and postwar recovery needs with 1949 correspondence on Japanese export pricing. Extensive tables document the 1930–34 economy and project production, consumption, and trade requirements for 1953. Diplomatic records trace complaints about low export prices and SCAP’s abolition of most export floor prices.
interest: The file pairs detailed prewar economic statistics and recovery projections with records of disputes over Japan’s postwar export prices.
